details: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde reportedly intervened to stop Binance's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) license approval in Greece. Her alleged aim is to block the exchange until the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) gains full MiCA authority and oversight. Concerns reportedly include the potential for USD-based stablecoins to undermine the Digital Euro, as well as Binance's past financial crime violations.
title: ECB's Lagarde Reportedly Halts Binance's EU MiCA License Bid

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act failed a procedural vote in the U.S. Senate, leading to a significant decline in Bitcoin, Ether, and major crypto company stocks like Coinbase and Circle. In response to the stalled legislation, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has submitted a proposal to the White House for regulating crypto transactions and markets. Separately, the SEC has cleared the way for trading venues to offer tokenized stocks in the U.S.
title: US Crypto Bill Fails in Senate, Sparking Market Dip; CFTC Proposes New Rules

details: The Federal Reserve raised its federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% on September 16, marking the first hike in over three years, citing persistent inflation. Despite initial pressure on risk assets, Bitcoin demonstrated resilience by rebounding past $80,000. This recovery was supported by renewed institutional inflows into Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), with Ethereum, XRP, and Solana also showing signs of recovery.
sourceName: VOIDTRACE AI (citing JPMorgan data via Wall Street Journal)
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $80K After Fed Rate Hike, ETF Inflows Return

details: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) implemented an expected interest rate hike, pushing borrowing costs to a 31-year high. The central bank also indicated the possibility of further rate increases in the future. This move contributes to a broader global trend of monetary tightening.
title: Bank of Japan Raises Rates to 31-Year High, Hints at More Hikes
